dishes.name: Çibörek
dishes.desc: Half-moon pastry of thin dough filled with spiced minced meat and deep-fried, usually eaten with ayran. A Tatar dish that Eskişehir has made its own, served around Odunpazarı.

dishes.name: Balaban
dishes.desc: Pide soaked in hot broth and topped with yogurt-tomato sauce, grilled meatballs, skewers, peppers and hot butter. A Tatar-rooted dish tied to Eskişehir's old kebab houses.

dishes.name: Met helva
dishes.desc: Crumbly flour, sugar and butter halva flavoured with cocoa and vanilla. Its name comes from a stick-and-knucklebone game, and Eskişehir treats it as its own sweet.

dishes.name: Höşmerim
dishes.desc: Halva-like dessert of fresh unsalted cheese cooked with flour, semolina and sugar, often topped with walnuts. A traditional Eskişehir sweet served in its pastry shops.

dishes.name: Sivrihisar muska baklava
dishes.desc: Triangular baklava shaped like an amulet (muska), with layered pastry and balanced syrup. A specialty of Sivrihisar, in the Eskişehir province.
